title: Lower Bounds for Randomized Linear-Oracle Optimization over Strongly Convex Sets
abstract: arXiv:2610.13590v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent results [arXiv:2602.04378, arXiv:2602.22608] have established worst-case objective-error lower bounds of order $1/T^2$ after $T$ linear minimization oracle (LMO) calls, matching the upper bound [arXiv:1406.1305] in its dependence on $T$ and thereby resolving a long-standing open question. Upon close inspection, however, both lower bounds are somewhat brittle. The first [arXiv:2602.04378] applies only to the standard Frank--Wolfe algorithm, and, as we show, its prescribed slow exact-line-search trajectories can amplify sufficiently small initialization errors exponentially, corresponding to roughly one additional bit of initialization accuracy per iteration. The second [arXiv:2602.22608] obtains lower bounds for any deterministic LMO-based first-order method via a resisting oracle that adversarially adapts to the queries of the algorithm. In both cases it is conceivable that randomization may circumvent these lower bounds; in par

translated_title: 强凸集合上随机化线性预言机优化的下界
translated_abstract: 近期的研究结果 [arXiv:2602.04378, arXiv:2602.22608] 建立了在 T 次线性极小化预言机（LMO）调用之后阶为 $1/T^2$ 的最坏情况目标误差下界，该下界在其对 T 的依赖关系上与上界 [arXiv:1406.1305] 相匹配，从而解决了一个长期悬而未决的开放性问题。然而，经过仔细审视，这两个下界都存在一定的脆弱性。第一个结果 [arXiv:2602.04378] 仅适用于标准的 Frank–Wolfe 算法，并且正如我们所证明的，其规定的缓慢精确线搜索轨迹可以将足够小的初始化误差指数级放大，相当于每次迭代大约需要额外一位初始化精度。第二个结果 [arXiv:2602.22608] 通过一个能够对抗性地适应算法查询的抵抗预言机，为任何基于 LMO 的确定性一阶方法获得了下界。在这两种情况下，可以设想随机化或许能够绕过这些下界；特别是……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对强凸集合上基于线性极小化预言机的优化问题，分析了现有 $1/T^2$ 最坏情况误差下界的脆弱性，并证明即使引入随机化，此类方法在 T 次 LMO 调用后仍无法突破 $1/T^2$ 的误差下界。
en_tdlr: This paper examines the brittleness of existing $1/T^2$ worst-case error lower bounds for linear minimization oracle optimization over strongly convex sets and shows that, even with randomization, LMO-based methods cannot beat the $1/T^2$ error bound after T oracle calls.
